review:
A neon Halloween Megaways game hosted by a skeleton. Wilds carry multipliers, and pumpkin scatters trigger one of three bonus versions.

In the bonus, coffins reveal a chosen character, extra spins or a multiplier – find five multipliers and they're released onto the reels. The buy lets you pick your volatility: Green (low), Red (medium) or Purple (very high, where the five multipliers are released twice). Base game is medium-high, 5,000x max, 97% RTP, and free spins land often – roughly once every 123 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
